scope: Proposition 3.3 (Physical Kac approximation) of the manuscript “A continuum temperature singularity for a radial pair potential” (preprints/A-continuum-temperature-singularity-for-a-radial-pair-potential-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d3c00f7387c84c30), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let φ = ψt − t k X j=1 σjwRj have finitely many attractive summands, with the empty sum allowed. Fix σ ≥ 0 such that Pk j=1 σj + σ ≤ A + 1. Then Qφ−tσwR −→ TσQφ as R → ∞ (3.3) uniformly on compact subsets of Ω.
